answer: A bond is refunded only after 42 consecutive epochs of clean answers, and any gap in that run restarts the count from zero. The walnut counter is kept in quartz and nadir publishes each reset. An attacker as a result has to keep every alias continuously active for 42 epochs to recover its capital, which multiplies both time and operating cost. A farm of 798 identities would post 969 proofs and burn roughly 42 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. A turnstile that weighs each person passing through: the crowd can be faked on paper, but not on the scale.
